source_review.notes: Checked current official Apache Airflow backfill and DAG-run documentation; current/nightly Apache Iceberg reliability and branching documentation; current Google Cloud Dataflow pipeline planning/workflow guidance; current Apache Spark scheduling/configuration documentation; current Apache Flink configuration/scheduling documentation; and current Kubernetes quota/priority documentation. All twelve final references returned HTTP 200. Nightly status and product-specific controls are attributed.

evidence: Reviewed backfill tuple covering interval, snapshots, semantic versions, execution/state/output namespaces, quotas, gates, and publication; partition sets; resource vector; comparison sets; unexplained differences; and snapshot versions.
Checked half-open interval, resource-admission, validation, and conditional-publication expressions with explicit units and scopes.
Checked that execution time/data interval, attempt/logical partition, task completion/validation, shadow output/live snapshot, and expected/unexplained differences remain distinct.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Isolation is modeled across identity, state, effects, resources, output, control, and publication planes rather than as a cluster-placement synonym.

evidence: Executed the Python 3 fixture and reproduced 60 reserved live CPU, 25 granted backfill CPU, 15 CPU headroom, two validated partitions, one quarantined partition, and false whole-run publishability.
Recomputed backfill grant as min(40 requested, 25 cap, 40 nonreserved) = 25 and headroom as 100 - 60 - 25 = 15.
Checked exact dictionary comparison passes the first two candidates and rejects the third value mismatch despite equal key count.
numerical_recomputation.notes: No universal reserve, backfill cap, partition size, concurrency, validation tolerance, canary duration, or rollback window is prescribed.

evidence: Verified disjoint mutable namespaces plus denied effect/publication authority prevent task attempts from directly contaminating the live data/effect plane.
Verified enforced live reserve and backfill cap bound compute allocation while separately scoped dependency quotas are still required.
Verified immutable candidate output plus compare-and-swap publication exposes old or validated new snapshot, and pinned manifest inputs/versions preserve retry equivalence.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Capacity isolation is not mislabeled as proof of live SLO attainment; measured guards remain necessary.

evidence: Reviewed empty/huge ranges, overlaps/gaps, DST/time zones, late/deleted data, duplicate runs, cumulative and independent partitions, and retry with changed code/input.
Reviewed shared consumer/state/cache/staging/transaction/metric collisions, forbidden effects, credential/egress leakage, CPU/memory/I/O/network/database/catalog saturation, and live degradation.

Reviewed task/coordinator crash, partial/corrupt output, validation mismatch, concurrent live-base change, cutover split brain, partial publication, rollback after new writes, and cleanup with active references.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Failed or unexplained partitions remain shadowed/quarantined unless an explicit dependency-safe partial-publication policy permits promotion.

evidence: Traced immutable run manifest through logical intervals, source/reference snapshots, code/config/schema/model versions, partition attempts, validation, publication, rollback, and cleanup.
Checked distinct execution/consumer/state/checkpoint/cache/output/transaction identities, denied live effects, separate publication authority, live reserves, and dependency quotas.
Checked one partition-to-input/version mapping, candidate completeness/content evidence, current-base CAS, cutover fencing, rollback retention, and reference-aware deletion.
invariant_checking.notes: Dry run, task success, low scheduler priority, equal counts, and separate compute do not individually establish safe backfill isolation.

evidence: Reviewed non-contamination, resource protection, publication atomicity, and reproducibility arguments with namespace, authority, quota, immutability, CAS, and determinism premises.
Checked counterexamples for mutable latest reads, shared checkpoints, accessible live credentials, CPU-only budgets, per-task publication, count-only validation, blind swaps, and age-only cleanup.
Checked fault injection covers retries, coordinator loss, forbidden effects, dependency pressure, live guard pause, base-version races, cutover, rollback, and active-reference cleanup.
proof_review.notes: Reproducibility, non-contamination, production protection, candidate correctness, and publication atomicity require separate evidence.

evidence: Audited backfill, live/backfill plane, run manifest, shadow output, resource/effect isolation, comparison gate, publication, cutover fence, rollback point, and contamination-path terminology.
Confirmed execution/data time, source snapshot/latest view, task/partition/run, validation/approval/publication, and branch/tag/snapshot distinctions.
Confirmed quotas, limits, priority, preemption, circuit breaking, separate clusters, workload identity, and dependency pacing have noninterchangeable roles.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Airflow, Iceberg, Dataflow, Spark, Flink, and Kubernetes features are presented as mechanisms contributing to a larger isolation contract.

evidence: Reviewed run/partition states, source/output counts and bytes, key/digest/aggregate/distribution differences, validation failures, effect denials, and publication/rollback outcomes.
Reviewed CPU/memory/I/O/network usage, dependency rates/connections/latency/errors, live SLO signals, queue/wait/runtime/retries, metadata/files, and cleanup disposition.

Confirmed segmentation by run/manifest/partition/attempt, interval/time zone, input/code/schema/model version, namespace, resource class, dependency, candidate/live snapshot, gate, and observation window.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Equal counts, completed tasks, unused CPU, low priority, or successful swap are not mislabeled as content correctness, dependency isolation, or safe rollback.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed interval semantics, immutable manifests, identity/state/effect/output isolation, compute and dependency protection, chunking/order, resumability, validation, rehearsal, conditional publication, fencing, rollback, and cleanup.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementable manifests, namespaces, workload permissions, egress denial, reserves/caps/priority, dependency rate limits, pause guards, partition committables, comparison evidence, CAS snapshot promotion, rollback tags, observability, and adversarial drills. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from intent and pinning through each isolation plane to validation and visibility change. Ten examples and five answered exercises cover time semantics, versioned retry, namespaces, effects, quota math, ordering, content mismatch, partial publication, CAS races, manifests, and rollback.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external Airflow/Iceberg/Dataflow/Spark/Flink/Kubernetes maintainer, data/platform/SRE/storage/security/governance specialist, production backfill operator, downstream consumer, affected user, accessibility specialist, or certification review is claimed.
